title: #30 Shopping Malls
prompt: In many towns and cities large shopping malls are replacing small local shops. Do you think this is a positive development? Give your reasons and examples.

promptSegments.text: In many towns and cities large shopping malls are replacing small local shops.
Do you think this is a positive development?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Shopping malls offer a wide variety of goods and services in one location, making them very convenient for customers.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Malls contribute to the growth of the local economy by attracting people to spend money and creating jobs.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Shopping malls are bad for small local shops because they make it hard for them to survive.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Shopping malls are bad for small local shops because they make it hard for them to survive.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Shopping malls hurt the local economy because people spend money in big chains instead of small local stores.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first benefit is the convenience that large shopping centres offer, as they provide a wide selection of goods and services in one place, eliminating the need for customers to travel to multiple locations.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Secondly, malls help boost the local economy by attracting people who spend money there, which increases local tax revenue and funds public services.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Secondly, malls help boost the local economy by attracting people who spend money there, which increases local tax revenue and funds public services.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The replacement of small local shops by large shopping malls is detrimental to community life and local economies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The replacement of small local shops by large shopping malls is detrimental to community life and local economies.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay highlights that local shops maintain unique community connections and character, which large malls fail to provide.
